description: One grouped PR for all minor/patch updates per week: every PR that touches package.json or bun.lock also deploys an Azure Static Web Apps preview environment for both sites, and the Free plan only allows 3 per app.
npm releases must be 3 days old before Renovate proposes them; bunfig.toml blocks releases younger than 2 days, so proposed versions always install.
Security fixes (from GitHub's Dependabot alerts) ignore the schedule and the PR limit and are raised immediately.
